Name: Radioactive Starsaber
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
This mod is basically a recolor of my first weapon mod "Starsaber". It's an overpowered sword in the colors of the radioactive ore. It comes with two different files, one that has the sword added to the AdventureShop for 1'000 gold and one where the sword costs 1'000'000 gold.

This mod comes with translation support and the language files in english (default), german, spanish and russian.


If you would like to contribute a translation, here's the text that's included:

﻿{
﻿"item.name": "Radioactive Starsaber",
﻿"item.description": "A blade from the deepest depths of the Valley.",
﻿}

Just write up a comment and I'll add it as soon as I can. :)


Thank you and Enjoy!
